issue_context.title: Display slider end and reverse arrow circle
issue_context.body:
**Proposal designs of the feature:** Disabled by default. Enabled if skin contains `hitcircle.png`. An option for that may or may not be added.

Very likely dupe & would do it myself.

review_comments:
I think this should be included inside the legacy implementation of `ReverseArrow` instead. You should be able to DI in the parenting hitobject and get the rotation from there.

Eventually I think we'll rename `ReverseArrow` to `RepeatPoint` or something like that.
